overview_description.description:
Capmo is the leading B2B SaaS startup revolutionizing one of the largest yet most antiquated industries in the world, construction and real estate. We have been awarded multiple times as one of the most innovative construction tech companies and have tripled our team in 3 years to nearly 70 employees from more than 15 countries. By the end of 2022, we will define the digital future of the construction industry in Germany, Austria and Switzerland so that homes, schools and hospitals, among others, can be built on time, on budget and CO2-efficiently in the future. 

The Munich-based software startup was founded in 2018. Several hundred customers and tens of thousands of users in Europe already rely on Capmo's digital solution and implement well over 10,000 construction projects with the software.

about_short_description.short_description: Capmo is developing construction management platform to make the hard things in construction feel easy.

product.name: Capmo Construction Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing construction projects by centralizing documents, tasks, and communication among all project participants.

product.name: Capmo AI Assistance
product.description: An AI-powered tool that automates routine construction management tasks such as information retrieval, change order review, and status comparisons.

product.name: Capmo Task and Defect Management
product.description: A module for capturing, tracking, and managing construction tasks, defects, inspections, and quality checklists directly on-site.

product.name: Capmo Project Planning and Control
product.description: A centralized tool for planning, coordinating, and controlling construction project schedules, plans, BIM models, and documentation.

product.name: Capmo Communication and Collaboration Environment
product.description: A common data environment that enables efficient collaboration and communication among all project participants without media disruptions.

product.name: Capmo Automation and Integration Services
product.description: Tools and APIs to automate construction processes, integrate with other software, and provide project analytics and insights.
